[[File:Icon-interior.png|40px|right]]
'''Interior''' is a [[Site]] icon. It marks a site that is conceptually "inside" (or partially inside): rooms, corridors, docking bay interiors, and the decks of [[Starship Site|starship]] and [[Vehicle Site|vehicle sites]]. The icon is printed in the icon boxes on the title bars of the location card. A site can carry the Interior icon on its own (an '''interior-only''' site) or together with the [[Exterior Site|Exterior]] icon (an '''interior/exterior''' site, typically a docking bay).<ref name="gl">[[Decipher Glossary 2.0#interior sites|Decipher Glossary 2.0]], "interior sites".</ref><ref name="ar">[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook#Interior Sites|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] (2023), "Interior Sites".</ref>

== Rules ==
=== Interior-only sites ===
At a site with the Interior icon and no Exterior icon:<ref name="gl" /><ref name="ar" />
* characters and vehicles may not [[Shuttle|shuttle]];
* vehicles may not deploy or move there unless their card specifically allows it.

The rules give the example of Tatooine: a vehicle may move to [[Tatooine: Docking Bay 94|Docking Bay 94]] (interior/exterior) but may not enter the [[Tatooine: Cantina|Cantina]] (interior-only). The vehicle's occupants have to disembark and move inside, leaving the vehicle at a nearby exterior site.<ref name="gl" />

This follows from the general location restrictions: [[Vehicle]]s may exist only at exterior sites (unless aboard a starship), and [[Starship|starfighters]] may exist at exterior sites, systems and sectors. One exception is the [[Lift Tube]], which can exist only at interior [[Mobile|mobile]] sites.<ref>[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] (2023), location restrictions.</ref> Starships therefore may not deploy to interior sites. The rulebook's start-of-game example is that you cannot start with Han, Chewie, And The Falcon at the Audience Chamber.<ref>[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] (2023), start of game.</ref>

=== Collapsing ===
Only an interior site can be "collapsed" (e.g. by [[Collapsing Corridor]]). When that happens:<ref>[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] (2023) and [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]], "collapsed site".</ref>
* all cards at the site are lost;
* the site's printed Force icons and game text are canceled;
* the site stays in play, but each deployment or movement to or from it costs 1 additional Force.

A collapsed site is "rebuilt" when either player deploys a new copy of it. Docking bay transit to and from a collapsed docking bay is still permitted.

Bombers use the icon too:<ref>[[Decipher Glossary 2.0]], bombers.</ref>
* at a related interior site, they may attempt "orbital bombardment" to collapse it, and the bomber does not move from the system;
* at a related non-interior site, they may "carpet bomb" it during a [[Bombing Run]].

=== Layout ===
On the table, a planet's interior sites and exterior sites are kept apart. A site that is both interior and exterior separates the two groups, often a docking bay.<ref name="lay">[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] (2023), location deployment.</ref>

The rulebook defines the "buffer sites" as Ahch-To: Jedi Temple, Capital City, Entrance Cavern, Ewok Village, Sith Temple Entrance, Turbolift Complex, Uplink Station and all interior/exterior docking bays. These may deploy only between the two groups. Any other interior/exterior site is laid out as if it were an exterior site.<ref name="lay" />

Starship and vehicle sites obey the same interior/exterior sequence, in their own group for their starship or vehicle.<ref>[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] (2023), starship and vehicle sites.</ref>

=== Game text ===
Many cards refer to interior sites directly. For example:
* [[Droid Detector]] deploys "at any interior site";
* [[Blast The Door, Kid!]] works "if a battle was just initiated at an interior site".<ref name="gl" />

[[Laser Gate]] deploys "between any two interior mobile sites". [[Path Of Least Resistance]] lets a character move between interior mobile sites.<ref>[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] (2023), relocation.</ref>
